content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. C1, the alleged harasser, is not shown to have been interviewed, and no coworkers who reportedly approached Complainant about the rumor were addressed. The Acting Lead Manager and Plant Manager, who allegedly received his reports, left no statements. The Lead Manager says the parties were separated, but no documentation or dates are cited, and the conflict over whether the rumor was reported is unresolved. Management's alleged disclosure of medical information and the August 7, 2018 investigative interview were not investigated beyond bare denials, and no comparator or policy evidence on the interview appears. The PS-13 was only mentioned, with no evidence of an anti-harassment inquiry. The Complainant never gave an affidavit, so the decision rests largely on his missing detail rather than on evidence gathered by the Agency. Although his non-cooperation explains some of the thinness, the Agency did not develop the record from other available sources, so the finding of no discrimination cannot be reliably evaluated."}
